'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Geoff Dearing DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' gdearing
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
